acceptance.given: A successful Replay Result is produced by the Toolchain replay evaluator.

oracle.expected: The Replay Result contains a separately computed dependency-verification record whose inputs and verdict are independent of the primary replay outcome.
forbidden: The Replay Result omits dependency verification.
Dependency verification is copied from or derived solely from the primary replay outcome.
oracle.observable: Parsed replay-result JSON contains dependency checks and an independent verification verdict.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result independently verifies dependencies.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Replay-result fixture without an independent dependency-verification record is rejected by the semantic validator.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay results to include a separately evaluated dependency-verification record while preserving existing replay verdict fields.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing replay-result fields remain readable; rollback only removes the independent dependency-verification requirement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful replay without independent dependency evidence becomes validation failure; evidence present remains eligible for acceptance.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when dependency verification is present, independently computed, and recorded in the successful Replay Result.

acceptance.given: Six materially distinct Matrix Cases and an immutable Candidate subject are configured for a Toolchain evaluation run.

oracle.expected: Every Matrix Case record contains one completed Candidate-subject execution bound to the same immutable Candidate identity.
forbidden: Any Matrix Case lacks Candidate execution.
Candidate identity or execution input changes during a case run.
oracle.observable: The matrix receipt lists six case records, each with completed Candidate execution and identical immutable identity binding.

acceptance.then: All six Matrix Cases have executed their immutable Candidate subjects.
acceptance.when: The six Matrix Cases are executed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A matrix fixture omitting Candidate execution for one required case produces a deterministic red result.

affected_subjects: Candidate subject execution across all six materially distinct Matrix Cases
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require matrix evaluation to execute and persist an immutable Candidate subject for each required case, with complete case records and stable identity binding.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Matrix artifact parsing and identity fields remain compatible if the completeness check is rolled back.

slice_hint.state_transition: Designated cases without complete Candidate records remain incomplete; immutable Candidate execution per case yields a complete matrix.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Matrix evaluation succeeds only when all six required case IDs each have a completed Candidate execution referencing one immutable Candidate identity.

acceptance.given: The three named evaluation-seed records are loaded from the Toolchain evaluation-seed source.

oracle.expected: Each uniquely named seed record contains a non-empty, readable applicability field.
forbidden: Any specified evaluation seed lacks applicability information.
A seed is duplicated or its applicability is unreadable.
oracle.observable: The parsed seed manifest contains exactly three unique named seeds and a readable applicability value for each.

acceptance.then: Each evaluation-seed record includes applicability information.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A seed-manifest fixture with applicability removed from any named seed fails the FR-6 semantic check.

affected_subjects: 评估种子的适用性信息
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require readable applicability metadata on each of the three named evaluation seeds while retaining all other FR-6 metadata requirements.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing seed records and other FR-6 fields remain compatible if only the applicability check is rolled back.

slice_hint.state_transition: Incomplete applicability metadata causes FR-6 validation failure; three readable applicability fields permit acceptance.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: FR-6 validation passes only when exactly three unique named seeds are present and each has non-empty readable applicability information.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation is assembled from the six required Matrix Case execution records.

oracle.expected: The aggregate verdict is failure whenever one or more required Matrix Case executions is absent.
forbidden: The aggregate passes with any missing required Matrix Case execution.
oracle.observable: Aggregate result JSON reports failure and identifies every missing required case execution.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is marked failed when any required Matrix Case execution is missing.
acceptance.when: Aggregate completion is evaluated with any missing Matrix Case execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: An aggregate fixture with one required Matrix Case execution removed deterministically returns a failed aggregate verdict.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make aggregate completion fail closed when any required Matrix Case execution record is absent, while reporting missing case identifiers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Aggregate JSON shape and case identifiers remain backward-compatible if the fail-closed rule is rolled back.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate with a missing required case is failed; aggregate with all required executions proceeds to normal verdict evaluation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate evaluator returns failure and lists missing case IDs whenever required case execution count is below six; it cannot return pass in that state.
